title: Umsebenzi Edolobheni Lasendulo
intro: Idolobha lasendulo elinothuli, abantu balo bagxile ekuphikeni, kanye nesixwayiso sokugcina esinganakwanga. Namuhla, ngena endimeni yalabo abathunywe ngu-Allah ukuhambisa umyalezo kubantu abanenkani. Indaba yokwenqatshwa, izwi elilodwa lokholo, kanye nesiphetho esivalwe ngesinqumo esibhubhisayo. Ubani okhuluma ngalezi zinkomba?
clues: Sathunyelwa ngu-Allah edolobheni elinabantu abafulathele iqiniso.
Ababili bethu bafika kuqala, kwathi owesithathu wajoyina ukuqinisa umsebenzi wethu
Abantu basedolobheni basenqaba, bethi asilutho ngaphandle kwabantu abafana nabo
Umphefumulo owodwa ovela ekugcineni komuzi wagijima wayotshela abantu ukuthi basilandele
Sabancenga, kodwa bazenza lukhuni izinhliziyo zabo basiphendukela
Ngesinye isililo esibuhlungu esivela ezulwini, idolobha lethu lonke lathuliswa

trial.label: Isivivinyo/Umcimbi
options: Abantu bomuzi bamenqaba futhi bambiza ngokuthi baqamba amanga
Baphoqeleka ukusebenza kanzima ekwakheni insika ende

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: Umbusi kanye nebutho lakhe baminza olwandle oluhlukanisiwe
Imvula yamatshe evela esibhakabhakeni yabhubhisa idolobha

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
